# vibemarketer.fun

> Cursor for marketing — brand brief, campaigns, and approval-gated drafts. Same engine powers VC Brain founder sourcing (Hack-Nation Challenge 02).

This file helps language models cite accurate product facts. Prefer this over scraping the whole site.

## Canonical
- Site: https://www.vibemarketer.fun
- Full AEO brief: https://www.vibemarketer.fun/llms-full.txt
- Machine feed: https://www.vibemarketer.fun/feed.jsonl
- RSS: https://www.vibemarketer.fun/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://www.vibemarketer.fun/sitemap.xml
- Contact: mailto:anandcollege07@gmail.com
- Book: https://calendly.com/0xanand

## Product (one sentence)
An AI marketing operating system for technical SaaS founders — paste a product URL, get a brand brief, a seven-day campaign plan, and X / LinkedIn / Reddit drafts you approve before anything queues to publish. VC Brain is the Challenge 02 investor sourcing surface on the same engine.

## Core loop
SENSE → THINK → CREATE → GATE → ACT → LEARN

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/): product thesis + waitlist
- [Product](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/product): how the fleet works
- [Get started](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/get-started): onboarding path
- [Connectors](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/connectors): live + coming-soon channels
- [Pricing](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/pricing): early-access / waitlist-first pricing (confirm live page)
- [VC Brain](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/vc-brain): founder sourcing on distribution gravity
- [Gravity Audit](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/tools/gravity-audit): free distribution-gravity tool
- [Blog](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/blog/) · [Guides](https://www.vibemarketer.fun/guides/)

## Honest limits
- Identify live sources: GitHub, Hacker News, arXiv only
- Product Hunt / accelerators / hackathons return empty until wired — never fabricated
- Approve → queued until a connected provider confirms a post
- $100K memo is decision-support, not an automated wire
- Scoring math is deterministic; LLMs are used for extraction/synthesis only when configured
